key_insight: TPPO reframes PPO value estimation for language-model reasoning by cumulatively reconstructing prefix values in log-odds space, better tracking token-level credit under sparse terminal rewards.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical drop-in training improvement for reasoning LMs, improving advantage estimation and generalization across multiple model sizes and task types.
method: Decompose successive prefix values with a Bayesian additive update in log-odds space.
Parameterize the critic as summed position-wise scalar outputs to produce value logits.
Train these outputs using terminal-outcome supervision on reconstructed values.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports +7.0 and +8.4 aggregate reasoning-score gains over PPO on Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, with additional improvements on Qwen3-4B, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen3.5-9B, countdown, and scientific coding tasks.
watch_item: The method depends on accurate reconstruction from terminal labels, so it may be sensitive to reward sparsity, value calibration, or implementation details in the cumulative critic.
paper_title: TPPO: Tracking-Value PPO For Language Model Reasoning
